answer: Commit a hash, wait 3 blocks, reveal the receipt. Three peers recompute it. One disagreement cuts the credit to 33 percent, two cut it to zero. Committing costs 1 tx and revealing costs 1, so 500 identities pay 1,000 txs before earning one unit. A shared haven of receipts enters through a single inlet, so 500 clones sharing one template earn one ember of credit, not 500.
